title: Topic 18
japanese_text: <u>カスタマー</u>サービスセンターにはお客様から<u>クレーム</u>の電話がかかってくる。なかには「責任者を出せ」と怒りを<u>あらわに</u>し、<u>肩書き</u>のある上司に電話を<u>取り次ぐ</u>と、すんなりこちらの<u>申し出</u>に応じる<u>厄介な</u>お客様もいる。
english_translation: The customer service center receives calls from customers about their complaints. Some of these customers are just troublesome. They openly express anger and demand to speak to someone in charge, but when the call is passed on to someone with a superior title, they're quick to accept any offer.
